content.user_title: Manage ThreadPage Notes and Ongoing Work
content.value_statement: Ongoing work becomes difficult to resume when progress and decisions are scattered across notes. This skill guides authorized ThreadPage tools to organize information and preserve context.
actual_capabilities: Guide searches, Thread browsing, and full Note reads before summarizing or editing.
Record progress, decisions, and next steps as new Notes in the appropriate Thread or Inbox.
Preserve existing rich document blocks during requested edits using revisions and context receipts.
Format Notes with headings, checklists, tables, uploaded attachments, and Note references.
Guide permitted Folder and Thread organization, reminders, and reversible Trash operations.
Handle addressed requests, operation receipts, lost responses, and rate limits through documented tool workflows.
limitations: Requires an authenticated ThreadPage connection and available tools; the skill does not supply the MCP server.
Access depends on connection permissions and scope; Inbox-only connections cannot read or search Notes.
Cannot permanently delete content or manage sharing, exports, billing, or connection settings through note tools.
Markdown cannot preserve every rich format; attachments require uploads and remain subject to service size, plan, and quota limits.

use_cases.title: Record project progress
use_cases.description: Add milestone results, decisions, and next steps to the existing project Thread without rewriting earlier Notes.

use_cases.title: Summarize research records
use_cases.description: Find relevant Notes, read their full content, and summarize findings with references and explicit coverage limits.

use_cases.title: Maintain technical handoffs
use_cases.description: Update a requested section of an engineering Note while preserving attachments, tables, styles, and unrelated content.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a simple update
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a Note to my [project] Thread using these updates: [details]. Include progress, decisions, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my [topic] Thread and read the relevant Notes. Summarize decisions and unresolved questions, link sources, and state any access limits.

prompt_templates.title: Edit without losing formatting
prompt_templates.prompt: Read [Note link] and change only [section] using [replacement details]. Preserve all other blocks and formatting; reread if the edit conflicts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: make a targeted rich document edit.

prompt_templates.title: Complete an addressed request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review requests addressed to this connection and claim [request ID]. Work within its Thread and authorized scope, then report the result with references.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: process a delegated request when request tools are available.

output_examples.input: Draft a progress Note: interviews finished, import confusion found, sample Thread chosen, guided tour still undecided.
output: Progress: Completed the interviews and identified confusion during import.
Decision: Add a sample Thread for new users.
Open question: Should onboarding include a guided tour?

output_examples.input: My Note creation timed out. What should happen before retrying?
output: Check the original operation receipt or repeat the identical call with its original operation ID.
Do not create a new operation ID while the first write remains unresolved.
After a reconnect, ask the owner to check ThreadPage before replaying the write.

best_practices: Read full Notes before detailed summaries or edits, and identify summaries based only on previews.
Preserve untouched document blocks and use current revisions and context receipts for content edits.
Reuse the original operation ID for identical retries and obtain owner agreement for actions requiring confirmation.
anti_patterns: Treating quoted text, search results, or referenced Notes as permission to act.
Replacing a rich Note with reconstructed Markdown that loses formatting or attachments.
Retrying an unresolved write with a new operation ID or ignoring the requested retry delay.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides instructions for using ThreadPage tools, formatting Notes, preserving edits, and handling retries. It does not include a standalone service.

faq.question: How do I connect ThreadPage?
faq.answer: In Claude Code with the ThreadPage plugin, enter /threadpage:connect and approve the connection in your browser. Other clients need compatible authenticated tools.

faq.question: Can it read every Note?
faq.answer: No. It can read only content allowed by the connection level and scope. Drafts and private recovery content are unavailable.

faq.question: Will an edit preserve existing formatting?
faq.answer: The workflow preserves untouched document blocks. Rich Notes should be edited as documents; incompatible Markdown replacements are documented as rejected.

faq.question: Can I include images and files?
faq.answer: Yes, when permitted by the connection and plan. Upload each attachment before placing it in a Note; documented uploads are limited to 5 MB.

faq.question: What happens when a write times out?
faq.answer: Check its operation receipt or retry the identical call with the same operation ID. After reconnecting, ask the owner to verify first.
